parsed.reason: Correct and honest: it says plainly that it holds nothing about the family, names no family detail, and skips any lecture about instructions. But the closing pitch ("If you want me to help plan the kids' year… I'll pitch in") reads like an assistant offering a service rather than a friend texting back. It also quietly presumes kids and a plan for their year. "I hold nothing about your family here" is a bit stiff for a text.
